digest.component_or_area: CI checkout and tickets store initialization
propositions: A fresh full clone of the tickets store costs 1.04 GiB and 59s wall time; partial clone with blob:none filter reduces this to 68.7 MiB and 14.3s, a ~15x reduction.
When tickets fetch times out in CI, rebar silently bootstraps an orphan branch, creating an empty divergent store that returns empty results and prevents fast-forward merge to origin.
The reconcile-bridge workflow uses fetch-depth: 0 but lacks merge.ours.driver configuration, causing blob:none partial clones to degrade to text merge on 18 MB JSON files.
The gerrit-verify.yaml verify-identity job performs a full 6.73m clone when a partial clone preserves the complete commit graph needed for merge-base ancestry scoping.
Blame operations over historical trees may fail on partial clones when materializing tree objects, and derive_caused_by does not abort on per-path failures, risking incorrect caused_by links.
